description:
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
 
Engagement Manager, CX Center of Excellence 

Why We Have This Role

At Qualtrics, we're building the category of Experience Management (XM). Our Global Customer Experience (CX) Center of Excellence runs our own CX program on the Qualtrics XM Platform and is changing how we listen to and act on customer feedback at scale. As an Engagement Manager, you'll help design and run that program, turning business needs into scalable solutions on the platform. You'll partner with GTM, Product, and Engineering teams, and what you build becomes a model for our customers: proof of what's possible when strong technology meets real customer obsession.

How You’ll Find Success

  • You build with depth on the XM Platform. You're at home with API integrations, web intercepts, AI capabilities, dashboards, and workflows, and you test until it works as designed.
  • You turn ambiguity into a plan. You take a business need, get the context from stakeholders, scope the requirements, and drive the project from planning through delivery.
  • You align people across teams. You bring GTM, Product, and Engineering around shared goals and build trust through clear, regular communication.
  • You own the outcome. You hold yourself accountable for high-quality, on-time delivery, and you prioritize hard when requests pile up.
  • You solve hard technical problems. When something breaks or doesn't exist yet, you diagnose it, bring in the right internal experts, and find a path forward.
  • You teach well. You can run a training for a global audience and leave people ready to use the program and act on what they learn.

How You’ll Grow

  • Get hands-on with new XM Platform capabilities, including AI-driven insights and new data integrations, as you pilot them inside our own program.
  • Shape the product directly. Your implementation feedback and feedback from our customers goes to Product and Engineering and informs where the XM Platform goes next.
  • Build visibility across the company by sharing program results and success stories.
  • Grow from implementer to program architect, designing a CX program that customers look to as a reference model.

Things You’ll Do

  • Set the standard for modern CX programs by designing and implementing end-to-end solutions on the XM Platform: surveys and web intercepts, enriched operational and behavioral data profiles, dashboards, workflows, and API integrations, all rigorously tested.
  • Help teams across Qualtrics act on customer insights faster by leading cross-functional scoping of strategic projects, documenting requirements, and keeping the work tied to business goals and timelines.
  • Increase program adoption by delivering global trainings on the CX platform and program, so teams know how to use it and act on what they find.
  • Keep the program high quality as it scales through regular maintenance, documenting stakeholder change requests, prioritizing enhancements, and resolving complex technical issues.
  • Accelerate innovation and influence the product by piloting new capabilities like AI-driven insights and integrated data sources, then sharing program insights, feedback loops, and success stories with GTM, Product, and Engineering.
  • Show the program's impact through advanced analytics and reporting that make insights and outcomes clear to stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For On Your Resume

  • A proven track record building CX programs on the Qualtrics XM Platform, especially API integrations, web intercepts, AI capabilities, data visualization, and reporting.
  • Hands-on experience in a technical role such as Technical Account Manager, Implementation, or Technical Success Manager.
  • Program management experience using methods like Six Sigma, Agile, or Scrum, with projects you took from scoping to delivery.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with examples of aligning cross-functional teams around a shared outcome

What You Should Know About This Team

  • We're our own first customer. We run our CX program on the XM Platform, so the program we build is the one customers look to as proof of what Experience Management can do.
  • Our work reaches the whole company. GTM, Product, and Engineering teams rely on what we build to understand customers and act faster.
  • We try what's next first. New AI and data capabilities get piloted in our program, and you'll be the one putting them to work.
  • We have a direct line to the product. What we learn from running the program feeds straight back to the teams building the XM Platform.

Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits

  • Global Wellness & Flexibility: Competitive time-off policies, flexible working arrangements, and wellness stipends to support work-life balance.
  • Comprehensive Health & Retirement: Industry-leading health coverage options and generous retirement matching programs.
  • Community & Inclusion: Active Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) and dedicated team-building events that foster a strong sense of belonging.
The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model: While this role is exempt from working in office, our hybrid work model remains elegantly simple for the rest of the company: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #remote
